purpose: Derive an exact off-shell second-variation master identity for the Einstein-Hilbert plus GHY sector of one C-PHYS-M1 bulk region and an explicit local fixed-interface Gaussian-normal boundary variation kernel. This is a gravitational control block; it does not yet combine the metric Hessian with WP1A matter-field metric mixing, cap Hessian, cap bending, perturbed junction conditions, gauge reduction or observables.

gravity_action_one_region.formula: S_g=(M6^4/2) int_M sqrt(-g)(R-2 Lambda6)+M6^4 int_Sigma sqrt(-h) K
gravity_action_one_region.boundary_type: non-null timelike cap in the project branch

first_variation_identity.formula: dS_g/d epsilon=(M6^4/2)[int_M sqrt(-g) E_AB (d g^AB/d epsilon)+int_Sigma sqrt(-h) Pi_ab (d h^ab/d epsilon)]
first_variation_identity.scope: fixed coordinate embedding of Sigma; GHY cancels normal-derivative variations of the metric from the Einstein-Hilbert term
first_variation_identity.interface_sign_crosscheck: With delta S_Sigma=-(1/2) int sqrt(-h) S_ab delta h^ab, summing the two outward-normal region terms gives M6^4 sum_s Pi_ab^(s)=S_ab, exactly the project Israel convention.

metric_path.boundary_induced: h_ab(epsilon)=hbar_ab+epsilon*q_ab for fixed embedding, q_ab=e_a^A e_b^B p_AB

exact_offshell_second_order_master.offshell_warning: Terms proportional to Ebar_AB and Pibar_ab are genuine off-shell terms and must not be dropped.
exact_offshell_second_order_master.coupled_parent_warning: Even on a future full parent on-shell background, Ebar_AB for the gravity sector alone generally equals M6^-4*Tbar_AB rather than zero. Cancellation/reorganization requires adding the metric second variations of scalar, Maxwell and cap sectors.

linearized_bulk_gravity_kernel.delta_R_AB: 0.5*(nabla_C nabla_A p^C_B+nabla_C nabla_B p^C_A-box p_AB-nabla_A nabla_B p)
linearized_bulk_gravity_kernel.derivative_order_note: Covariant-derivative ordering is part of the formula; curvature terms appear explicitly if derivatives are commuted.

assumptions: Sigma is kept at fixed coordinate location in a boundary-adapted Gaussian-normal neighborhood
p_nn=0 and p_na=0 in that control neighborhood
q_ab is the tangential metric perturbation
no cap embedding/bending field is included in WP1B
fixed_interface_gaussian_normal_boundary.gauge_firewall: This local fixed-interface Gaussian-normal control does not prove equivalence to the full cap-bending sector and does not close diffeomorphism gauge control.

independent_control_checks.six_dimensional_constant_conformal_scali: For p_AB=c*gbar_AB on a constant-curvature background, the bulk master coefficient reproduces the direct epsilon^2 coefficient of sqrt(-g)(R-2 Lambda6) under g_AB -> (1+epsilon*c)gbar_AB.
independent_control_checks.flat_background_local_conformal_ricci: For p_AB=2*sigma*gbar_AB in a flat local frame, delta R_AB=-(D-2)*partial_A partial_B sigma-gbar_AB*box sigma with D=6.
independent_control_checks.gaussian_normal_boundary_matrix_check: The covariant and coordinate forms of delta K_ab, delta K and delta Pi_ab agree for arbitrary symmetric local q_ab, partial_n q_ab and Kbar_ab.
independent_control_checks.israel_sign_check: The first-variation boundary sign reproduces the project EQ-007 Israel matching convention when combined with the cap stress definition.

what_is_proven_here: exact pathwise off-shell EH+GHY second-variation master identity in terms of delta E_AB and delta Pi_ab
explicit linearized Einstein-plus-cosmological bulk kernel for covariant metric perturbations
explicit local fixed-interface Gaussian-normal boundary momentum variation kernel
consistency of the boundary first-variation sign with the project outward-normal Israel convention
what_remains_open: full metric-scalar and metric-Maxwell second variation and mixing with WP1A
cap embedding/bending perturbation or a globally justified fixed-interface gauge
mu eta Sigma growth and lensing
ghost freedom, kinetic positivity, gradient stability and physical spectrum
forbidden_inferences: Do not drop Ebar_AB terms by assuming vacuum Einstein equations; C-PHYS-M1 contains scalar and Maxwell stress.
Do not interpret the local Gaussian-normal fixed-interface control as a proof that cap bending is absent or pure gauge globally.
Do not infer ghost freedom, positivity or stability from the existence of the gravity Hessian master identity.
Do not infer a released physical background, 4D gravity map, Poisson/slip/lensing relation or growth law.
Do not authorize solver execution or promote K1-D/K1-E.
